_doc: OB-237 Phase A — canonical registry of all Wix-side snippets AccessSync expects operators to install. Source of truth for Setup Hub UI rendering, version detection, and Test Connection round-trips. Adding a new member-facing surface = add an entry here. Bumping current_version triggers stale-install detection on next operator login. Templates are static text; runtime substitutes {{CLIENT_ID}}, {{ADMIN_HUB_URL}}, {{CORE_ENGINE_URL}} server-side from env + operator scope.

snippets.name: events.js — Velo Backend Webhook Forwarder
snippets.description: The Velo backend file that forwards Wix Pricing Plan, Bookings, and Member events to AccessSync. Without this installed, NO door access provisioning happens. Most critical snippet in the system.
snippets.wix_install_path: Wix Editor → Dev Mode → Backend → events.js
instructions: Open your Wix Editor and click Dev Mode in the top menu bar
Go to Dashboard → Developer Tools → Secrets Manager
Add a secret named 'accesssync_webhook_secret' with the HMAC value from the Webhook Setup card below
In the left panel, click Backend → + New File → name it 'events.js' (replace contents if it exists)
Save and publish your Wix site

snippets.name: Post-Purchase Status Button
snippets.description: Adds a button to your Thank You page (and Bookings confirmation page, if used) that opens the member's Access Hub straight to the live setup animation, in a genuine new browser tab — a real click, so it's never blocked by a popup blocker the way an auto-opened window on page load would be. Nothing renders inside Wix (no iframe). Optional — without this, members can still reach their status manually via the My Access button, but this gives them a direct nudge right after checkout instead of having to know where to look.
snippets.wix_install_path: Wix Editor → existing Thank You page (and Bookings confirmation page, if used) → add a Button element (id btnViewStatus) → Velo Dev Mode → page code
instructions: In your Wix editor, open the Thank You page that members see after completing a plan purchase
Add a Button element to the page (e.g. labeled "View My Access Status") and set its ID to 'btnViewStatus'
Open the Velo Dev Mode code panel for that page
Repeat on your Bookings Confirmation page if you use Bookings

snippets.name: My Access Page (Member Hub)
snippets.description: Member-facing self-service page showing active door access, plan details, and family-plan management. Opens in a new browser tab from a Button on your Wix member page — no iframe, no manual height-setting.
snippets.wix_install_path: Wix Editor → your Member Area page → add a Button element (id btnMyAccess) → Velo Dev Mode → page code
instructions: In your Wix editor, add a Button element to the member page where members should see their access (e.g. a custom 'My Access' tab), and set its ID to 'btnMyAccess'
Open the Velo Dev Mode code panel for that page
